scientific_integrity: Exact formulas proved using three-state transfer-matrix diagonalization and a cyclic Fourier identity; independent enumeration for n=3,...,9 is supplementary finite validation, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fugacity one only; finite-size mode extremizers not classified; analogous lattice-gas structure-factor formulas may exist in historical work. The ratio theorem is asymptotic, with exact finite matrices characterized by explicit spectral formulas. The calculation is neither independently audited nor claimed as a formal certification.
title: Two-branch Fourier spectra for uniform hard-core configurations on cyclic prisms
